attchmntText: Indo Amines Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Indo Amines Limited filed its Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended 30th September, 2026 with the National Stock Exchange of India. The results were published in the Mumbai Edition of The Free Press Journal and Navshakti on 8th November, 2026. The company also disclosed that its Annual General Meeting for the financial year ending 31st March, 2026 will be held on 5th November, 2026. Additionally, State Bank of India issued an E-Auction Sale Notice for the sale of immovable properties under the SARFAESI Act. The auction for properties mortgaged by borrowers Ramkripal Ramswarath Chaurasiya and Omkar Ramesh Misal is scheduled for 9th December, 2026. The reserve prices are Rs. 11,00,000/- and Rs. 26,00,000/- respectively.
